description: Args for op 118 rql_query (execution + explain). Server recompiles any source and never trusts a client plan_hash. The default profile is Application Core; Full is selected explicitly.

profile.description: Execution profile. Omitted is equivalent to core; full selects server-side rql-full-v1.

source.description: Optional UTF-8 RQL source in the selected profile. When present, server recompiles.

plan.description: Optional logical RqlPlanV1 object for builders; server validates or recompiles.

explain.description: When true, return structured explanation and do not enumerate rows.

continuation.description: Opaque residiuum-cursor-v1 token from a prior page.
